/// Maximum delay between attempts, in milliseconds.

## Retry policy

`run_job` accepts a `RetryConfig` with `max_attempts`, `base_delay_ms`, and
`max_delay_ms`. `max_attempts` includes the initial call. Only
`RetryError::Transient` failures are retried; permanent failures are returned
immediately. Retry delays start at `base_delay_ms` and double after each
failure, saturating at `max_delay_ms`.

The sleeper is injected through the `Sleeper` trait, so callers can provide a
real sleeper and tests can use `FakeSleeper` without waiting.
